description: This file contains driver code for Renesas R-Car pin control, including register definitions, functions for setting pin modes, drive strength, voltage, and initialization routines.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a pin control register, first writing the inverse to PFC_RCAR_PMMR, then the actual value.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_set_gpsr
methods.description: Sets a pin as GPIO or peripheral function based on the 'peripheral' flag.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_set_ipsr
methods.description: Sets the peripheral function for a pin.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_drive_reg
methods.description: Retrieves the drive register associated with a pin, along with offset and size.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_set_drive_strength
methods.description: Sets the drive strength (in mA) for a specific pin.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_bias_reg
methods.description: Finds the bias register and bit for a pin.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_set_bias
methods.description: Configures pull-up or pull-down bias for a pin.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pin
methods.description: Configures a single pin based on provided settings.
